title: cold-outreach-builder prospect dossier
description: One file per prospect, <run>/dossiers/<prospect_id>/prospect.json, written by the research step (one sub-agent or one sequential pass per prospect). Every fact carries a date, the URL it was read on and a verbatim excerpt of that page; scripts/verify_dossiers.py checks each excerpt against the cached page cache/<hash>.txt. Validated with shared/scripts/validate_json.py (stdlib subset of JSON Schema).

email.description: Only an address the person published for professional contact, with that page in email_source_url, or one the founder supplied. Never guessed from a naming pattern.

email_source_url.description: URL of the page that publishes the address, or lead_list when it came from the founder's list.

linkedin_url.description: Profile URL as given in the lead list. The profile page itself is never scraped (login wall and terms of use): facts come from public posts and other public pages.

geography.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase, empty when unknown.

language.description: Language the person writes in publicly.

register.description: French only: the form of address the person uses publicly; n/a for other languages.

relationship.description: Anything other than none sends the prospect to tier C: the founder writes to people they know, the sequence does not.

pages_read.description: Every URL read for this dossier, each cached under cache/ with scripts/cache_page.py.

claim.description: The fact in one sentence, in the researcher's words.

date.description: Date of the event or the publication, read on the page (or from a LinkedIn or X post id). A fact without a readable date is not a fact for this agent.

date_source.description: Where the date comes from. post_id is checked against the id in source_url.

excerpt.description: Verbatim words copied from the page at source_url. Checked by verify_dossiers.py against cache/<hash>.txt.

owner.description: self: the prospect wrote or said it; company: the company published it; third_party: press, registry, someone else.
